journey.name: Agent Factory
journey.journey_tagline: How every agent goes from hypothesis to a governed agent in production: DevSecOps with GitHub Copilot, evaluations first and a human at every gate
journey.vision: Every agent is specified, built, evaluated, reviewed and released the same way: as code, through pull requests, with evaluations as the definition of done.
journey.ai_contribution: Factory agents draft specifications, evaluation sets, code, reviews and release notes; people approve every gate.
journey.business_impact: Shorter lead time from idea to pilot, fewer failed releases, auditable agents and predictable cost.

factory.title: Agent Factory: from hypothesis to a governed agent
factory.intro: The Agent Factory is the journey every agent takes: a DevSecOps loop with GitHub Copilot, evaluations first and a human at every gate, following the Copilot Studio lifecycle (create, build, test and evaluate, publish, monitor). The board shows where each agent of this blueprint stands; the steps show how it moves on.

steps.name: Build (DEV loop)
steps.what: Task by task in a branch: a failing evaluation case, then the build, then the case passes. Agents are pushed to DEV from the repository.

steps.name: Verify (pull request)

steps.name: Release

tools: Microsoft Purview: data loss prevention and audit

adr_canon.title: Build every agent through the Agent Factory
adr_canon.context: Agents built by clicking in one environment cannot be reviewed, reproduced or promoted safely.
adr_canon.decision: Agents are specified, built, evaluated and released as code through pull requests with human approval; the GitHub Copilot harness where it fits.
adr_canon.consequences: Needs a repository, a pipeline and builder licences (IT readiness); every agent follows one quality bar.
adr_canon.alternatives: Build per environment in the maker portal; export and import solutions by hand.

adr_canon.title: Read-only first; writes only after a separate gate
adr_canon.context: Writes into systems of record carry the highest risk.
adr_canon.decision: MVP agents read and draft; every write goes through a declared action held by a workflow and a person's confirmation, opened after its own review.
adr_canon.consequences: Value starts with drafting and advice; automation grows with evidence.
adr_canon.alternatives: Writes from day one with approval prompts only.

adr_canon.title: Systems of record stay authoritative
adr_canon.context: Copies of master data in agents drift and leak.
adr_canon.decision: Agents act through connectors and declared actions on the systems of record; they keep no copies of master data.
adr_canon.consequences: Integration effort per system; data stays where it is governed.
adr_canon.alternatives: Replicate data into the agent's knowledge.

adr_canon.title: One landing-zone pattern for every agent
adr_canon.context: Agents appear in default environments without rules.
adr_canon.decision: A managed environment per journey and stage inside environment groups, with data policies, identities and budgets from one template.
adr_canon.consequences: Environments are created on purpose; every journey starts compliant.
adr_canon.alternatives: One shared environment per stage for all journeys.

adr_canon.title: Aggregated signals only
adr_canon.decision: Quality, value and cost are measured per agent, process or team, never per employee.
adr_canon.consequences: Works-council and data-protection alignment is simpler; no individual performance views.

adr_canon.title: Evaluation is the definition of done
adr_canon.context: Without evaluations, quality is a feeling and regressions go unnoticed.
adr_canon.decision: No build task without a failing evaluation case; releases gate on agreed thresholds (evaluation pyramid L0 to L5).
adr_canon.consequences: Evaluation sets are part of the handover package; thresholds are agreed with the business owner.

adr_canon.title: Pay-as-you-go until a usage baseline
adr_canon.decision: Copilot Credits on pay-as-you-go with budgets and alerts; capacity packs or pre-purchase only after three months of measured usage.
adr_canon.consequences: Slightly higher unit price at the start; no stranded commitment.
adr_canon.alternatives: Capacity packs or a pre-purchase plan from day one.

items.item: A repository for the Agent Factory starter kit, with branch permissions for the build team
items.why: Specifications, evaluations and agents live as code

items.item: Branch protection or rulesets, code owners and a named approver for pull requests and releases
items.why: People approve every change

items.item: Secret scanning with push protection, and pipeline service connections to DEV and TEST
items.why: No secrets in code; secretless deployment

items.item: GitHub Copilot policies for the Copilot CLI and MCP servers, and an allow-list of plugins and skills
items.why: Only approved tools reach the build team

items.item: Tool approval for the GitHub Copilot CLI and open-source factory add-ons where the policy requires it
items.why: The build team works with approved, pinned tools

items.item: Developer workstations prepared to the workstation standard below, or a Dev Box or virtual machine
items.why: Builders can run the factory locally

items.item: Proxy and firewall allow the GitHub, GitHub Copilot and Power Platform endpoints and the package registries
items.why: Copilot and the CLI work on the customer network

groups.title: Systems of record, data and knowledge

items.item: A bill of materials of all systems of record the agents touch, with API availability and owners
items.why: Integration effort and owners are known before the build

items.item: Read-only test access or synthetic data for the prototype; no production system touched
items.why: Safe prototyping

items.item: Knowledge sources for the prototype: approved SharePoint sites and libraries
items.why: Grounded answers from approved content

items.item: Architecture documents and non-functional requirements (naming, data residency, security standards)
items.why: The design follows the customer's standards

items.item: Data-protection and works-council position for the prototype, including consent for knowledge capture
items.why: No surprises in the pilot

decisions.options: GitHub Enterprise Cloud, Azure DevOps or a combination
decisions.recommendation: GitHub when the approval covers private repositories linked to Entra ID; otherwise Azure DevOps or a combination

decisions.options: One environment per journey and stage, or shared environments per stage
decisions.recommendation: A managed environment per journey and stage inside environment groups (ADR-F04)
decisions.owner: Power Platform team with data protection

decisions.options: Power Platform pipelines, GitHub Actions or Azure Pipelines
Agent files and solution sources in Git, or the maker portal
decisions.recommendation: The repository is the source of truth (ADR-F01)

decisions.options: User-delegated, service-owned connections or managed identities
decisions.recommendation: Service-owned connections with least privilege for workflows; delegated identity where the user's rights must apply

decisions.options: Open plugin marketplace, or an allow-list with pinned versions
decisions.recommendation: An allow-list with pinned versions, reviewed before upgrades

decisions.options: From the agent identity kit, or per project
